title: Solstice concert
note: A short invented chat. Scored spellings are in the replaced turns. One spelling is only in the kept tail.

messages.content: We have to be performance-ready by the solstice concert.
The piece is Byrd Ave verum. We sing it in G minor.
Book room Linden, not the gym.
Linden it is. The gym is out. Mira will not take the solo; the section sings it.
The yellow folders are on the piano.
